claims.behavior: Exact default-enabled independently staged checkbox; legacy import, Apply/Cancel/reopen and concurrent field-scoped save. Real thumbnail local transfer reads the saved corresponding gate; enabled yes/no question uses captured selection and explicit source, disabled gate performs the same membership operation immediately. Retired/hidden questions and switched pages cannot write; captured and live stable keys prevent reused IDs retargeting. Strict skips existing destinations, merge includes them, and deleted destination restores original time before source deletion.
limits: Rust/model/native tests are authored for hosted CI; no local Cargo builds, Rust tests or mutation runs.

Only explicit-source local thumbnail commands consume these gates in this slice. Viewer/remote locations, shortcut source chooser, progress/cancellable block worker and removal-from-view preferences remain outside scope. Broader parents stay Partial.

Native uses one synchronous transaction and rechecks live memberships and stable service keys; a disappearing source is skipped and replaced services error atomically. Large jobs currently block the GUI thread.
